candidateEvaluations.strategy: Present a streamlined mobile rewards overview focusing primarily on points balance and clear category grid navigation for discovery, incorporating recent activity below the fold.
Present recent activity at the top of the mobile screen followed by points balance and category grid.

approvedCustomerStory.oneSentenceStory: The customer checks their current rewards balance and reviews primary redemption categories to understand their purchasing power.
approvedCustomerStory.customerSituation: The customer arrives at the mobile rewards overview seeking clarity on their accumulated points.
approvedCustomerStory.storyTension: Uncertainty regarding the current total value and the available categories for redemption.
approvedCustomerStory.customerResolution: Viewing an accurate points balance alongside a clear category grid of redemption pathways.
approvedCustomerStory.primaryOutcome: Effortless understanding of available rewards value and next redemption step.

journeyCandidates.journeyObjective: Provide a clear, mobile-optimized overview of rewards balance and primary redemption categories.
journeyCandidates.completionDefinition: The user successfully views their points balance and interacts with or explores the category grid.
episodeSketches: Episode 1: Display POINTS_BALANCE prominently at the top of the mobile viewport.
Episode 2: Present CATEGORY_GRID directly below for browsing redemption options.
Episode 3: Render RECENT_ACTIVITY for supplementary transparency.
